user.title: Homeslice
user.description: Adds the Homeslice card to your dashboards. Put your house model in `homeslice/home.yaml` inside your configuration folder.

missing_floor.title: Homeslice: floor {ref} no longer exists
missing_floor.description: House **{house}** links level {level} to the floor `{ref}`, which Home Assistant doesn't have anymore. Link the level to another floor or restore the floor.

missing_area.title: Homeslice: area {ref} no longer exists
missing_area.description: House **{house}** links room {room} to the area `{ref}`, which Home Assistant doesn't have anymore. Link the room to another area or restore the area.

missing_entity_opening.title: Homeslice: entity {ref} no longer exists
missing_entity_opening.description: House **{house}** uses `{ref}` for a door or window of room {room}, but Home Assistant doesn't know this entity anymore. Pick another entity or remove the link.

missing_entity_facade.title: Homeslice: entity {ref} no longer exists
missing_entity_facade.description: House **{house}** uses `{ref}` for the façade window {opening}, but Home Assistant doesn't know this entity anymore. Pick another entity or remove the link.

import_files.name: Import house files
import_files.description: Imports every YAML file in the homeslice folder of your configuration into Homeslice's storage. The file name is the house id. Houses last saved in the editor are skipped unless forced.

force.name: Force
force.description: Also overwrite houses that were edited in the editor.

show.name: Show on the house
show.description: Open Homeslice cards fly to an area, a floor or an entity for a while (e.g. from Assist: "Show the living room").

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to stay there (default: the card's follow time).

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Shows a message on every open Homeslice card (at its area, if given) and speaks it on that area's speakers.

area.name: Area
area.description: Area id or name: where to show it and whose speakers say it.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Floor id or name to show.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Show it where this entity is.

media_player.name: Speakers
media_player.description: Speak on these instead of the area's own.

tts.name: Text-to-speech
tts.description: The engine to speak with (default: the first one).

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long cards show it (default: the card's follow time).

show_nothing.message: Name an area, a floor or an entity to show.
